question: Iron-deficiency anaemia is the single most prevalent nutritional disorder among Indian adolescents, and adolescent girls are disproportionately affected compared to boys.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Iron-deficiency anaemia is the dominant nutritional disorder in Indian adolescents, and girls are disproportionately affected because of menstrual blood losses superimposed on an already iron-poor diet.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. NFHS-5 data confirm that 59.1% of adolescent girls aged 15–19 years in India are anaemic, primarily due to iron deficiency compounded by menstrual losses, inadequate dietary iron, and poor absorption. This motivates the WIFS (Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation) programme.
